label: High-risk AI systems shall use datasets meeting quality criteria
definition: High-risk AI systems shall be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria referred to in paragraphs 2 to 5.

label: Datasets shall be subject to appropriate data governance practices
definition: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose.

label: Governance shall concern relevant design choices
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] the relevant design choices.

label: Governance shall concern data collection processes and origin
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] data collection processes and the origin of data, and in the case of personal data, the original purpose of the data collection.

label: Governance shall concern data-preparation operations
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] relevant data-preparation processing operations, such as annotation, labelling, cleaning, updating, enrichment and aggregation.

label: Governance shall concern formulation of assumptions
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] the formulation of assumptions, in particular with respect to the information that the data is supposed to measure and represent.

label: Governance shall concern assessment of dataset availability and suitability
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] an assessment of the availability, quantity and suitability of the data sets that are needed.

label: Governance shall concern examination for biases affecting health, safety, rights
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] an examination of possible biases that could affect health and safety or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law.

label: Governance shall concern identification of data gaps and shortcomings
definition: [Data governance and management practices shall concern in particular] the identification of any data gaps or shortcomings, and how those gaps and shortcomings can be addressed.

label: Datasets shall be sufficiently representative
definition: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be sufficiently representative for the intended purpose.

label: Datasets shall have appropriate statistical properties for persons/groups
definition: Datasets shall have the appropriate statistical properties, including as regards the persons or groups of persons on which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

label: Datasets shall account for characteristics of the deployment setting
definition: Datasets shall take into account the characteristics particular to the geographical, contextual, behavioural or functional setting of intended use.

label: Special categories personal data may be processed for bias detection
definition: Providers may process special categories of personal data strictly necessary for bias detection, subject to appropriate safeguards.

label: Bias cannot be fulfilled by synthetic/anonymised data alternatives
definition: Ensuring bias detection cannot effectively be fulfilled by processing other categories of data, including synthetic or anonymised data.

label: Special data subject to technical limitations and state-of-art security measures
definition: Special categories data subject to technical limitations on re-use and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures.

label: Special data deleted when bias corrected or retention period ends
definition: The data shall be deleted once the bias has been corrected or the retention period has expired.

label: For non-training AI, paragraphs 2-5 apply only to testing datasets
definition: For high-risk AI not using training techniques, paragraphs 2-5 apply only to the testing data sets.
